title: Chat history popover
description: Header control to search and browse threads (recency grouping, keyboard-friendly).
content:
Chat history popover

Header control to search and browse threads (recency grouping, keyboard-friendly).

What this is

The history popover (clock or list icon in the header) shows recent conversations with search and recency grouping so you can jump back quickly.

How to use it

  • Click the control, type a few characters to filter by title or content preview.
  • Select a row to load that conversation.
  • Use delete (trash) on a row to remove one thread; confirm if asked.

Notes and limits

Very long histories may take a moment to index on first open after update.
